title: WHEN THE BATTLE'S OVER
author: Isaac Watts
stanzas: Am I a soldier of the cross, a follower of the Lamb? And shall I fear to own His cause or blush to speak His Name?
Must I be carried to the skies on flowery beds of ease, while others fought to win the prize and sailed through bloody seas?
Sure I must fight if I would win; increase my courage, Lord; I'll bear the toil, endure the pain, supported by Thy Word.
chorus: And when the battle's over we shall wear a crown! Yes, we shall wear a crown! Yes! we shall wear a crown And when the battle's over we shall wear a crown In the new Jerusalem wear a crown (Wear a crown) Wear a crown(Wear a crown) Wear a bright and shining crown; And when the battles over we shall wear a crown In the new Jerusalem
